units.source_text: 源氏公子叫工人重新疏导东边廊房下流出来的泉水，

en.t: Prince Genji had the workmen clear and redirect the spring water flowing out from beneath the eastern corridor,

units.source_text: 自己脱下官袍，仅穿内衣，亲去指示，其姿态异常优美。

en.t: and he himself took off his court robe, wore only his inner garments, and went personally to give directions; his figure was extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 那尼姑看了欢喜赞叹不置。

en.t: The nun watched with delight and could not stop praising him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见一旁有佛前供净水的器具，

en.t: Prince Genji noticed nearby the vessels used to offer pure water before the Buddha,

units.source_text: 想起了那尼姑，说道：“师姑老太太也住在这里么？

en.t: and, remembering the nun, said, "Does the venerable nun also live here?

units.source_text: 我太不恭敬了。”

en.t: I have been terribly disrespectful."

units.source_text: 便命取官袍来穿上，

en.t: He then ordered his court robe to be brought and put it on,

units.source_text: 走到尼姑居处的帷屏旁边，言道：“小女能长得如此美好而无缺陷，

en.t: then went to the curtain screen beside the nun's quarters and said, "That the young girl could grow up so lovely and without any flaw

units.source_text: 全是太君修行积德之故。

en.t: is entirely because of your reverend practice and accumulated virtue.

units.source_text: 太君为了我等，舍弃了心爱的静修之处而重返尘世，

en.t: For our sake, you left the beloved place of quiet religious retreat and returned to the world,

units.source_text: 此恩诚非浅鲜。

en.t: and this kindness is truly no small matter.

units.source_text: 而老大人独居浦上，对此间定多悬念。

en.t: Meanwhile the old gentleman lives alone by the shore and must surely be very anxious about matters here.

units.source_text: 种种照拂，感谢不尽！”

en.t: For all your care and consideration, I cannot thank you enough!"

units.source_text: 这番话说得情意缠绵。

en.t: These words were spoken with deep and tender feeling.

units.source_text: 尼姑答道：“能蒙公子体谅我重返尘世之苦心，

en.t: The nun replied, "If you, my lord, understand the painful resolve with which I returned to the world,

units.source_text: 老身延命至今，也不算虚度光阴了。”

en.t: then this old body has not lived on until now in vain."

units.source_text: 说到这里，哭了。

en.t: Having said this, she wept.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“这一棵小小青松，生长在荒矶之上，实甚可怜。

en.t: Afterward she continued, "This small green pine grew upon a desolate rocky shore, and it was truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 现在移植丰壤，定当欣欣向荣，诚可庆喜。

en.t: Now that it has been transplanted into rich soil, it will surely flourish; that is truly something to celebrate.

units.source_text: 但恨托根太浅，

en.t: Yet I regret that its roots were set down too shallowly,

units.source_text: 不知有否障碍，深可悬念耳。”

en.t: and I cannot know whether some hindrance may arise; that is what deeply worries me."

units.source_text: 这话说得很有风度。

en.t: She spoke these words with great dignity.

units.source_text: 公子便和她话旧，

en.t: The prince then talked with her about old times,

units.source_text: 追述尼姑的祖父中务亲王住在这邸宅里时的情况。

en.t: recalling what things had been like when the nun's grandfather, Prince Nakatsukasa, had lived in this mansion.

units.source_text: 此时那泉水已经修好，

en.t: By then the spring had already been repaired,

units.source_text: 水声淙淙，仿佛泣诉旧情。

en.t: and the water murmured as though tearfully telling of old memories.

units.source_text: 尼姑便吟诗道：

en.t: The nun then composed a poem:
